Bats flap across the citadel as long banners sway and thin clouds drift through moonlight.

Moonlight falls across flowers and arched windows as she waits in black and white for a gentle encounter.

Blue and violet neon illuminate the night, framing silver hair and a black-and-gold outfit in futuristic elegance.

A crimson gown lights up the grand ballroom, and her glance makes the evening shine a little brighter.
